about_the_game:
The Turning of the Leaves Fantasy Adventure


A strange rage is affecting the normally-docile fey and forest animals around the village of Axefell. Unless the heroes can track down the source, the isolated villagers are doomed!

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:
  • A four-part adventure designed for 3-5 Novice characters.
  • Twenty-one Stat blocks for new adversaries.
  • Easy to use drag and drop Encounters to make combats simple to manage.
  • All the images and handouts from the book are available to share with your players as you need them.
